caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded vase positioned centrally on a light beige background. The vase features a wide body with a slightly narrower, circular opening at the top, shaded in shades of purple. The lower third of the vase is colored brown, suggesting a ceramic or terracotta material. The upper portion of the vase is a light gray or off-white color, adorned with a network of greenish-blue vertical and diagonal lines, resembling an organic or vine-like structure that wraps around and over the surface. Between these greenish-blue lines, faint leaf-like shapes are visible, forming a repeating decorative pattern. The entire composition is rendered with fine, delicate lines and subtle shading that provides volume to the vase, with light and shadow suggesting a gentle, diffused lighting source from the upper left. The drawing is centered on a textured, rectangular area, which itself is mounted on a larger, plain background sheet with minor discoloration at the corners. No other objects or elements are depicted in the image.
title: Vessel
